statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
CPT code 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The symptoms are directly related to the underlying cardiovascular conditions
